answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A bridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ridge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the timber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
